title: Opening Ceremony: Welcome to Devcon 8 India!
description: Devcon team welcomes you to Mumbai and to Devcon 8. This session sets the scene for the days ahead introducing the host city, the venue, and everything the event has to offer. From the nine programming tracks to workshops, community hubs, and community-led sessions, we'll walk you through how it all fits together and how to make the most of your time here. Get oriented, get inspired, and get ready for an unforgettable Devcon.
